title: How boats float
examples: Teacher, why do big ships not sink?
If I put a rock in water, why does it go down?
What makes something float in the water?

explain.say: Today you will learn why some things float on water.
A boat sits in the water, pushing some water away. The water pushes back up on the boat.
The shape of a thing helps it float.
The push up from the water has a name. It is called buoyancy.
A toy boat floats because its wide shape pushes lots of water away.
A common mistake is to think heavy things always sink. Big ships are heavy, but their shape lets them float on the water.

items: It is the shape and water push.
Not just how heavy it is.

faq.q: Why does a boat float but a stone sinks?
faq.a: A boat is shaped to push lots of water out of the way. A stone is heavy for its size, so it sinks.
asks: Why does the boat stay up?
What makes the boat float better than the rock?

faq.q: Is it only the size that makes something float?
faq.a: No, the shape is also very important for floating. A wide, flat shape helps push more water.
asks: Can a small thing float if it has the right shape?

faq.q: What is the push that pushes things up in the water?
faq.a: That upward push is called buoyancy. It is the water pushing back up on the object.
asks: What is the name for the upward push?
Where does the push come from when floating?

faq.q: Does the boat have to be light to float?
faq.a: No, a boat can be made of heavy things but still float. Its shape keeps it up in the water.
asks: Does weight matter if the shape is good?

faq.q: How much water does a boat need to push away?
faq.a: It needs to push away enough water so that the water pushes back up with a stronger push.
asks: What is the balance point for floating?

facts: Floating objects push water out of the way.
The shape of an object helps it float.
Buoyancy is the upward push from the water.
A boat pushes water away to stay afloat.

quiz.say: You shape some clay. Which shape floats best?
quiz.why: A wide dish pushes away lots of water. The water pushes it up.

wrong.0: A tight ball of clay pushes away little water, so it sinks.
wrong.2: A thin stick of clay pushes away little water, so it sinks.

quiz.say: What is the push up from the water called?
quiz.why: Buoyancy is the water pushing up on a boat.

wrong.1: Weight is how heavy the boat is, and it pulls down.
wrong.2: Gravity pulls things down, and this push goes up.

quiz.say: A big ship is very heavy. Why does it float?
quiz.show: 🚢 Why does a heavy ship float?

options.show: it is light as a feather
options.say: it is light as a feather
its wide shape pushes water away

quiz.why: The wide shape pushes away lots of water. The water pushes the ship up.

wrong.0: A big ship is very heavy, so its shape is what keeps it up.
wrong.1: A big ship is huge, so its shape is what keeps it up.
